# References {.unnumbered}

Sources are grouped by topic. Books are cited with their latest edition known at the time of this revision; living online documents without editions are cited without a date and should be checked at their source. Specifications and standards are cited by their maintaining body; consult the maintainer for the current version before relying on specific clauses.
